accepted_claims: Four bounded native/process fast paths now have explicit sufficient source-bound admission predicates; operation names and kernel success are not admission or correctness evidence.

Native B-rep/process output is accepted from a fast provider only with an independent material certificate; kernel validity and kernel topology identity are not canonical material, body or lineage authority.

The dispatcher is noncycling: at most one fast provider may run, any failure/uncertified result/success-without-certificate falls back exactly once to a unique GENERAL_CERTIFIED_ROUTE, and that route never dispatches back to a fast provider.
The general route is total as routing but may terminate with preserved proof blockers, UNCERTIFIED, RESOURCE_REFUSAL or SEMANTIC_BLOCKER rather than fabricating success.
Multi-setup material-changing operations are independently dispatched in the MC-023 common frame while exact revision/body binding and inherited error remain continuous.
Directional, mesh/Manifold and sparse-volume/level-set candidates remain derived accelerators or challengers rather than canonical authority.
open_claims: PB-007-01 remains OPEN for unconditional tangential/multiple/singular transcendental event decisions.
PB-007-02 remains OPEN for unconditional general coupled spindle/feed/eccentric sweep membership.
PB-007-03 remains OPEN_PROPAGATED for a universal finite exact source codec covering arbitrary admitted form/undercut cutters.
RB-016-02 remains OPEN for durable multi-body mapping and independent engineering-output preservation.
RB-016-04 remains OPEN for exact-zero/touching/singular independent-consumer output qualification.
No native provider has been newly qualified for total-domain material correctness, robustness, scale or production use by MC-030.
MC-B, MC-C, MC-D, MC-E, MC-F and MC-1 remain NOT_ESTABLISHED.
adversarial_controls: reject operation labels as sufficient provider admission
reject unresolved nonlinear/MC-058 uncertainty from exact fast paths
reject accessible undercut without complete cutter-plus-holder access evidence
reject phase-sensitive turning from the axisymmetric path
reject transcendental blockers from bounded phase-provider success
reject stale or missing revision/body binding
reject B-rep validity or kernel topology identity as canonical material/body/lineage authority
reject fast SUCCESS without independent material certificate
reject provider cycles or general-to-fast redispatch
reject derived directional/mesh/sparse candidates as canonical authority
reject positive-material deletion, exact-zero healing, inherited-blocker closure and premature gate promotion

review.disposition: completed bounded native/process provider-admission and total noncycling dispatch design; general-route proof/output blockers remain explicit and no native capability is promoted
review.downstream_release: MC-026 may consume the provider/dispatch design together with MC-024/025/027/028/029 and MC-049 evidence; MC-030 does not release MC-B or authorize native/paid execution

downstream_invalidations: Any dispatcher that admits by operation label, drops source/common-frame/revision/body binding or resets inherited uncertainty invalidates the matching fast-path claim.
Any provider success accepted without an independent material certificate, or any promotion of kernel topology to durable identity, invalidates MC-030 authority separation.
Any cycle, general-to-fast redispatch, timeout/refusal laundering or blocker-to-success conversion invalidates the total-dispatch result.
Future native qualification may supplement individual fast paths but must not rewrite historical negative evidence or close unrelated proof/output blockers without producing-owner evidence.
